targetUrl.title: Storefront URL
targetUrl.description: Public URL of the storefront to audit. It must serve GET /api/cart for cart verification.

taskText.title: Customer task
taskText.description: Plain-English task given to the shopping agent. Keep it identical across compared runs.
taskText.default: Find a black running shoe under $120 in size 8 that is in stock, and add it to my cart.

expectedSku.title: Expected SKU
expectedSku.description: The only cart item that counts as success.

repetitions.title: Runs
repetitions.description: How many times to run the agent (1-5). Each run costs model API credits.

runLabel.title: Run label
runLabel.description: Optional note saved with the results, e.g. a commit or patch ID.
